{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the unique values in 'channel'
print("Unique values in 'channel':", sales['channel'].unique())

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded))"}
